executors.description: Inventory and apply a colour/font-only theme while preserving the editable source deck.

actions.description: Inspect the source deck's slide count, explicit colours, fonts, and preserved text before choosing a theme map.

inputs.name: source-path
inputs.description: Absolute workspace path of the materialized source .pptx.

inputs.name: report-path
inputs.description: Absolute workspace path for the generated inventory JSON.

actions.result: A source inventory with slide count, explicit colours, fonts, and text-preservation facts.

actions.description: Apply the selected complete colour/font map to a new PPTX and record a preservation receipt. Use after writing the deck-specific theme JSON from the inventory.

inputs.name: source-path
inputs.description: Absolute workspace path of the materialized source .pptx.

inputs.name: output-path
inputs.description: Absolute workspace path for the new themed .pptx.

inputs.name: theme-path
inputs.description: Absolute workspace path of a deck-specific theme JSON with all theme roles and explicit-colour mappings.

inputs.name: report-path
inputs.description: Absolute workspace path for the generated transformation receipt JSON.

actions.result: A new themed PPTX and a receipt proving the transformation and source-preservation checks.
